title: tailscale-status
description: Payload published retained by the Tailscale plugin to renewvan/tailscale/status. Reports daemon state, authentication, Tailscale IP, hostname, and online peer count. Published every 30 s and on state change.

enabled.description: True when the tailscaled daemon is installed and running.

connected.description: True when authenticated and BackendState is Running.

ip.description: Tailscale IPv4 address (100.x.x.x), or null when not connected.

hostname.description: Tailscale machine hostname, or null when not connected.

peers.description: Number of currently online Tailscale peers.
